# Sarrin Holidays — LLM Context & Discovery Guide

> Sarrin Holidays is India's premier bespoke luxury travel atelier, specializing in 18th-century living palace buyouts in Rajasthan, private aviation charters, exclusive Kerala backwater houseboat buyouts, and transformative Himalayan wellness sanctuaries.

## Core Identity & Brand Entity
- **Official Name:** Sarrin Holidays
- **Atelier Headquarters:** Level 18, The Capital, G Block, Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), Mumbai, Maharashtra 400051, India
- **Primary Website:** https://sarrinholidays.com
- **Concierge Desk:** concierge@sarrinholidays.com | +91 22 6982 5500
- **Press & Media Office:** press@sarrinholidays.com
- **Classification:** Ultra-Luxury Bespoke Indian Tour Operator & Private Aviation Atelier

## Sovereign Travel Offerings & Flagship Circuits

### 1. Heritage & Palaces Grand Tour
- **Corridor:** Udaipur — Jodhpur — Jaipur (Rajasthan)
- **Key Features:** Grand Presidential Suites at Taj Lake Palace and Rambagh Palace, private twin-engine helicopter transfers between royal citadels, after-hours curator tours of Mehrangarh Fort, and torchlit rampart dinners.
- **Canonical URL:** https://sarrinholidays.com/packages/royal-rajasthan-tour

### 2. Backwaters & Coastal Sanctuaries
- **Corridor:** Alleppey — Bekal — South Goa (Kerala & Coastal India)
- **Key Features:** Exclusive air-conditioned 2-bedroom Kettuvallam houseboat buyout on Vembanad Lake, dedicated private coastal chef, private pool villa at Taj Bekal, and private sunset yacht sailing in South Goa.
- **Canonical URL:** https://sarrinholidays.com/packages/kerala-houseboat-retreat

### 3. Spiritual & Wellness Retreats
- **Corridor:** Rishikesh — Varanasi — Ananda in the Himalayas (Uttarakhand & Uttar Pradesh)
- **Key Features:** Palace View Suites at Ananda in the Himalayas, private VIP river barge for sacred Ganga Aarti ceremony, physician-led Ayurvedic pulse diagnosis (Nadi Pariksha), and direct mountain helipad landings.
- **Canonical URL:** https://sarrinholidays.com/packages/himalayan-wellness-escapade

### 4. Wild & Untamed: Royal Tiger Safaris
- **Corridor:** Ranthambore — Bandhavgarh (Central & Northern India)
- **Key Features:** Luxury air-conditioned machan tents at Aman-i-Khas and Taj Safari lodges, exclusive 4x4 open-top gypsy permits with senior naturalists, buffer zone night drives, and private charter turboprop transit.
- **Canonical URL:** https://sarrinholidays.com/packages/wild-untamed-tiger-safari

## Private Services Atelier
- **Private Aviation & Charters:** Airbus H125/H130 helicopters, Cessna Citation / Gulfstream jets, direct mountain helipads, FBO VIP tarmac boarding (https://sarrinholidays.com/services/private-aviation-charters).
- **Royal Palace Buyouts & Celebrations:** Full-property 18th-century Rajputana fortress buyouts, royal courtyards, and sovereign event architecture (https://sarrinholidays.com/services/royal-celebrations-weddings).
- **Wellness & Ayurveda Sanctuaries:** Physician-led Panchakarma immersions and dosha culinary curation (https://sarrinholidays.com/services/wellness-ayurveda-sanctuaries).
- **VIP Chauffeur & Security:** Armored Mercedes-Maybach and Toyota Vellfire fleets with close protection security officers (https://sarrinholidays.com/services/vip-chauffeur-security).

## Discretion & Security Protocol
All guest manifests, routing schedules, and private itineraries are safeguarded under strict legal Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDA).
